subject: Aurora Digital – Phased Capacity Bridging & Commitment Plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroradigital.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <marcus@auroradigital.ai>, procurement@auroradigital.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora usage heading into renewal - quick sync?

Hi Priyom,

We're starting budget reviews for next year and want to make sure the renewal conversation reflects what we actually use. Over the past 3 months we've seen a spike in generation traffic (long-form summarization flows) during North American peak hours — average utilization on reserved pools reported at ~82%, with short spikes up to ~95%. We appreciate the burst credits last quarter but need a more predictable runway.

Can we discuss a phased approach: an initial tranche add for Q1 (short lead time), then a reassessment before Q3 to decide on a full commit? Also need to understand lead times for additional H100 slots and any potential SLA impacts.

Thanks,
Lena
Head of Platform Engineering
Aurora Digital

Attachment: usage_snapshot_nov2026.csv (referenced)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroradigital.ai>
Cc: Marcus Chen <marcus@auroradigital.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora usage heading into renewal - quick sync?

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the snapshot. We can absolutely structure something phased so you get predictable capacity this winter while keeping flexibility.

High-level proposal:
- Phase 1 (Q1 start): +40 H100-equivalent slots as a reserved tranche (3-month evaluation window) to smooth the 82-95% peaks.
- Phase 2 (by July): reassess using the Redwood Optimize telemetry and decide on conversion to a longer-term commit (6–12 month options).

I want to involve Sales Ops to confirm lead times and pricing. Are you open to a short call Wednesday 11/18 to walk the mutual action plan and timing?

I'll prepare an initial capacity schedule and attach an SOW draft.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Aurora usage heading into renewal - capacity ask (need pricing + lead times)

Kimberly / Aditya — forwarding Aurora's ask. Key points:
- They want +40 H100-equivalent reserved slots for Q1 with a 3-month evaluation, then reassess for a possible 6–12 month commit.
- Their current observed utilization is ~82% avg with spikes to 95%. They value predictability more than lowest price.
- Procurement will want clear lead time and SLA note if we add reserved capacity.

Can you run a quick config/pricing options and confirm if we can provision 40 H100-equivalent within 4–6 weeks? If not, what is a feasible bridging option (mixed GPU types or burst credits)?

Thanks — I want to have a candidate mutual action plan and SOW by EOD tomorrow for the Wed call.

— Priyom

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora usage heading into renewal - capacity ask (need pricing + lead times)

Priyom — thanks for the heads up. Quick ops note and pricing options:

Operational feasibility:
- We can provision 40 H100-equivalent slots within 5 weeks if we use a mixed provisioning strategy: 28 H100 reserved + 12 H800 short-term burst-convertible nodes. Full H100-only within 8–10 weeks due to supply.
- SLA: reserved tranche will carry the standard Dedicated SLA; bridge H800 nodes will be tagged as "burst-compatible" with an explicitly lower availability target in the SOW until converted.

Pricing options (ballpark to be refined):
- Option A (Phased Convert): $X/slot-month for 28 guaranteed H100 + $Y/slot-month for 12 burst H800. Convertible pricing credit if converted within 90 days.
- Option B (Short-term Bridge): All 40 on burst-convertible pricing for 3 months (lower immediate cost, higher risk for performance-sensitive flows).

Ask for the Wed call: confirm Aurora's tolerance for mixed-GPU bridging, and whether they require guaranteed IOPS/latency for those 12 slots.

I'll attach a draft SOW and capacity schedule for your call prep.

— Kimberly
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurora_capacity_schedule.xlsx

From: Marcus Chen <marcus@auroradigital.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroradigital.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora usage heading into renewal - quick sync?

Priyom / Kimberly — thanks for the proposal. We prefer Option A (Phased Convert) because the production flows are latency-sensitive and we don't want to risk consistent degradation with all-burst nodes. A mixed approach sounds reasonable if you can guarantee conversion windows and a convertible credit.

We can do Wed 11/18 at 10:00 PT. Procurement will join and will want to see: lead time commitment, conversion credit language, and an explicit timeline for the 90-day evaluation.

Also: instead of committing to a full 6–12 month at conversion, would Redwood offer a 6-month minimum convert commitment with a prorated adjustment if they convert after 90 days? That would help our budgeting.

— Marcus
Director of Platform Operations
Aurora Digital

Cc: procurement@auroradigital.ai

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@auroradigital.ai>, Marcus Chen <marcus@auroradigital.ai>, procurement@auroradigital.ai
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Aurora – Mutual Action Plan + Draft SOW (attached)

Team — great call today. Summary and next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Phase 1 (Target start: 2027-01-04)
   - Provision: 28 reserved H100-equivalent slots + 12 H800 bridge slots (convertible).
   - Lead time: provisioning targeted at 5 weeks from signed SOW; H100-only full conversion expected in 8–10 weeks if needed.
   - Metrics: Redwood to provide weekly utilization dashboard; Aurora to run predefined eval prompts for quality/latency checks during the 90-day window.

2) Evaluation and Conversion (90-day window)
   - If conversion is requested within 90 days, Redwood will apply a conversion credit that applies to previously paid burst pricing and amortizes toward the committed rate.
   - On conversion, conversion term minimum: 6 months (prorated) unless both parties agree to a different term.

3) Pricing and Signatures
   - Draft SOW attached (Aurora_SOW_v3.pdf) and capacity schedule (aurora_capacity_schedule.xlsx).
   - Procurement requested DocuSign link will be provided; we will include the conversion credit language and lead-time SLA in the SOW.

Action items: 
- Priyom: upload final SOW with conversion clause and HubSpot deal note by 11/20 EOD.
- Kimberly: confirm the exact $/slot numbers and the convertible credit % for conversion.
- Aurora procurement: review SOW and confirm legal redlines.

If that summary looks right I'll route the SOW for signatures and set up the provisioning playbook with infra.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Aurora stable for Q1.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurora_SOW_v3.pdf, aurora_capacity_schedule.xlsx, redwood_capacity_note.pdf
